candidates.name: Tuberous Sclerosis Complex
support_spans: dozens of skin-colored dome-shaped papules over the chin, nasal, and perinasal regions of the face
Histologic Analysis: First biopsy of facial papule showed a dome-shaped lesion with several plump fibroblasts and increased blood vessels, compatible with an angiofibroma
candidates.why: The presence of multiple angiofibromas and the patient's history of a renal transplant at a young age are consistent with Tuberous Sclerosis Complex.

candidates.why: The presence of multiple angiofibromas and conical teeth, which are characteristic features of Tuberous Sclerosis Complex, along with the histologic analysis, supports this diagnosis.
